name: The Reports
summary: Senir Whitebeard sends an urgent report from Kharanos to Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge. He warns that the senator is sour and asks you to keep the scout who gathered the information unnamed.

sections.title: A Dispatch to the Capital
sections.body: Senir Whitebeard needs you to carry an urgent report from Kharanos to Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge. The mountaineer’s account details the growing Frostmane troll threat facing Dun Morogh, drawn from reconnaissance deep inside Frostmane Hold. Senir asks you not to mention who helped gather the information from the snowy crags.

sections.title: Friction in the High Seat
sections.body: Senator Barin Redstone reacts with anger when you deliver Senir’s report in Ironforge’s royal court. The senator bristles at the report’s use of King Magni’s authority to sanction Senir’s operations. His response reveals resentment in the Senate toward the King’s decrees and field initiatives carried out in his name.

faq.answer: Senir Whitebeard is a dwarven mountaineer stationed near Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He oversees scouting and military reconnaissance against Frostmane trolls encroaching on dwarven settlements.
Barin Redstone is a sour, aristocratic dwarf senator who resides in Ironforge’s throne room near King Magni Bronzebeard. He is easily annoyed by common petitioners.

faq.q: Why is Senator Redstone angry about the report?
faq.answer: Senir warns you that Senator Redstone is sour. You learn the senator’s response when you deliver the report.

faq.q: Why does Senir Whitebeard ask to keep your help secret?
faq.answer: Senir Whitebeard asks you to keep your help secret so his superiors will believe he completed the arduous scouting himself. He does not want to admit that an adventurer carried out the mission.

aliases: where to turn in the reports
faq.answer: You deliver the report to Senator Barin Redstone in the High Seat of Ironforge, the great chamber where King Magni Bronzebeard holds court.

faq.q: What does this quest reveal about Ironforge politics?
faq.answer: The delivery introduces Ironforge’s Senate and the officials who receive frontier reports. Redstone’s reaction gives you a glimpse of Ironforge politics.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see the balance between King Magni’s crown and the dwarven Senate’s parliamentary power when you deliver the dispatch in the High Seat.
As an Alliance member, you see Ironforge’s civic layout and the bureaucracy that shapes Alliance domestic policy.
